title: Learning Grand Pas de Quatre with Miss Barbara - Robbie 15

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher guides students through ballet choreography, combining demonstration with video review on a tablet. She provides constructive feedback and encourages dancers as they practice.

lesson_structure.note: Dancers perform the pas de quatre choreography in the studio.
Teacher discusses the ending position and technique with dancers.
Teacher and dancers review performance footage on a tablet.
Dancers perform the routine again with piano accompaniment.

steps_taught.name: Grand Pas de Quatre variation
steps_taught.description: Ballet variation performed on pointe in the studio

what_works: Visual review of practice on tablet
what_hinders: Lack of verbal breakdown of steps

quotes.text: The last one's not hard, but it's hard to stop.

evidence_segments.observation: Dancers performing ballet turns and jumps across the floor in pointe shoes

extraction.distinctive_method: Using a tablet to review video playback of the dancers' rehearsal on the spot.
